# langsmith_dataset_share (Resource)

Manages the public share state of a dataset. Creating this resource generates a share token; destroying it unshares the dataset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_dataset_share" "golden" {
  dataset_id     = langsmith_dataset.golden.id
  share_projects = true
}

output "share_token" {
  value = langsmith_dataset_share.golden.share_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) UUID of the dataset to share.

### Optional

- `share_projects` (Boolean) Whether to also expose linked projects in the share.

### Read-Only

- `share_token` (String) The generated share token (used as the path segment in shared URLs).
